title: Efficient and Accurate Prompt Optimization: the Benefit of Memory in Exemplar-Guided Reflection

layout.note: One tall panel (a) at the left and two stacked panels (b) above (c) at the right, each with a coloured frame and title bar. Inside (b) and (c) the memory storage is at the left, labelled Retrieval and Update arrows in the middle, and the prompt and output boxes at the right. Two elbow arrows run from the output in (a) to the two storages.

lesson: Show a text-driven method with its real text: colour each span of the prompt by role (instruction, feedback, exemplar, generated prompt) and keep the colours identical in every panel and in the memory the span is stored to, so the data flow can be followed by colour alone.
